usage: deskops message [-h] {send,wake,list,read,ack} ...

Send, list, read, or acknowledge cross-desk messages.

positional arguments:
  {send,wake,list,read,ack}
    send                Send a message to a project desk.
    wake                Wake the desk's scion identity for a note (exit 3 when
                        the memory gate blocks).
    list                List received messages.
    read                Read one received message.
    ack                 Acknowledge one received message.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops message send "Need follow-up" --to sibling-repo --title "Follow-up"
  deskops message list --root .
  deskops message read 20260614-cli-help --root .
  deskops message ack 20260614-cli-help --root .
  deskops message wake --root . --note 20260614-cli-help

read/ack selector: filename, stem, or unique slug fragment.
